upload.title: Upload a CSV file
upload.noAccountBody: Imports go into an account. <link>Add an account</link> first.
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MiB. Split it into shorter periods.
upload.footer: Trading 212 reports and supported Slovak bank exports with Debet/Kredit transaction types are recognised automatically. Other formats need a mapping once, which is remembered for later files. The file goes straight into encrypted storage and is not kept on disk.

history.title: Import history
history.emptyBody: Upload a CSV file to review it before anything reaches your ledger.
history.kept: Every upload is kept with its mapping, counts and problems, including failed ones.

optional.externalIdColumnHint: Recognises rows on reimport. Without it, IDs come from the row values.
optional.categoryColumnHint: Used when no rule assigns a category.
optional.notesFallbackColumnHint: Used when the notes column is empty.
optional.feeAmountColumnHint: Kept as metadata. The amount column already includes it.

actions.intro: Tell Spend212 what each value in the action column means. Rows with a value that is not listed are held back until you choose.
actions.valuePlaceholder: Value as written in the file

mapping.title: Column mapping
mapping.asking: Asking Jev to map the columns. Only the column names and the first 3 rows are sent.
mapping.saved: Saved the mapping and checked every row.
mapping.suggested: Jev suggested this mapping from the header and at most 3 rows. Review it, then save.
mapping.filledBody: Jev chose these columns from the column names and the first 3 rows. Check them, then save to validate every row.
mapping.suggestFailed: Jev could not suggest a mapping
mapping.suggestFailedBody: {error} Map the columns yourself, or ask again.
mapping.headerless: This file has no header row, so its first line is a transaction and each column is shown by its value on that line.
mapping.reused: Saved mappings are reused for files with the same columns.
mapping.newAuto: This format is new. Jev maps it automatically from the column names and the first 3 rows, and nothing is saved until you review it.
mapping.newManual: This format is new. Map the columns yourself, or set up TypeSafe in Settings to have them mapped automatically.
mapping.fixed: One currency for the whole file
mapping.actionHint: A column such as Card debit or Deposit that tells the kind of row.

correction.restored: Restored row {row} to the file's values.
correction.title: Correct row {row}
correction.description: Change the values as they should have appeared in the file. The original values stay in the import history.

row.conflict: The source changed since the last import. Importing flags the existing transaction for review and keeps your edits.
row.duplicate: Already in the ledger, so it is skipped.

rows.checkAgain: Check the rows again before importing.
rows.title: Rows
rows.numbering: Row numbers count records after the header, so a note spanning two lines is still one row.

detail.scheduled: Monthly Trading 212 report for {month}, into {account}. Downloaded <date>{created}</date>
detail.failedBody: {message} Nothing was added to your ledger.
detail.stillUploadingBody: The file is still being read.
detail.unknownActionsBody: Choose what these values mean in the mapping below. Nothing is guessed.
detail.errors: {count, plural, one {# row needs correction} other {# rows need correction}}
detail.errorsBody: Correct or exclude these rows, then check again. Nothing is imported while any row has a problem.
detail.nothingAdded: No new transactions were added, so there is nothing to review.
detail.added: {count, plural, one {# new transaction was added.} other {# new transactions were added.}}
detail.confirmedOn: You confirmed {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} on {date}.
detail.addedReview: {count, plural, one {# new transaction was added and waits for your review.} other {# new transactions were added and wait for your review.}} Correct anything that is wrong, then confirm the import. Confirming changes no values.
detail.categorized: TypeSafe picked the category of {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}.
detail.categorizedReview: Check them before confirming. The categories you keep or correct become payee rules.
detail.conflicts: {count, plural, one {# existing transaction changed at the source and is flagged for review.} other {# existing transactions changed at the source and are flagged for review.}} Your edits were kept.
detail.deletePrompt: Delete this import and its staged rows? Your ledger is not changed.
